The Top 100

Researchers active on Goldbach and adjacent problems

The list is sortable on any column. Type in the search box to filter by name, institution, or country. Click any name for that researcher's profile page.

This page shows the 100 highest-ranked living researchers, renumbered 1 to 100. Researchers in the ranked pool who have passed away are remembered on the In Memoriam page.

Reading the columns. arXiv rank, OA rank, and zbMATH rank are the researcher's position in the full composite score for each of three pipelines. Each composite is 60% paper count + 40% eigenvector centrality on the co-authorship graph, computed over: arXiv (155 qualifying authors across 17 search terms), OpenAlex (1,113 authors across 13 phrase queries), and zbMATH (790 authors across MSC classes 11P32, 11N05, 11N13, 11N36, 11P55, the additive-prime-number-theory subfield). The overall rank is the sum of the three (sum_rank), so lower is better in every column. A value in [square brackets] is interpolated: the researcher did not appear in that pipeline directly, so their rank there is estimated from their position in the others. See the methodology for how. A dash means no estimate was possible.

Provenance breakdown

  • both: in arXiv 155 AND OpenAlex top pool. The unanimous core.
  • oa_only: discovered by OpenAlex but not arXiv-active. These are senior figures who publish in journals and don't post preprints.
  • arxiv_only: present only if at least one arXiv-only entry made the sum_rank cutoff.
  • manual_add: manually inserted via gb_manual_additions.csv.
